policy.scope: Predictive model descriptions, with explicit method allowlists and recipe overrides. Other entries remain unreviewed or not applicable.
policy.evidence: Documentation-informed classifications; transparency is expert judgement. These labels do not change capability, installation, integration or runtime-validation evidence.
policy.capacity_growth: Stage 2: reserved, not assessed or used for filtering.
policy.outputs: Prediction outputs replaces Formulation. Regression summaries distinguish Point prediction from Point prediction & spread using documented prediction-specific uncertainty outputs, without a calibration claim. A single quantile, coefficient uncertainty, residual variance or dispersion among ensemble members alone does not establish prediction-spread support.
policy.composition: Multiple labels describe nested composition; no guarantee transfers automatically from components to their aggregate.
policy.learning_strategy: Timing of predictive model construction: eager fits a reusable predictor before queries; lazy defers local estimation or neighbor aggregation to each query; hybrid combines eager and lazy predictive components. Ordinary preparation and neighbor-index construction do not alone change this classification. Strategy is not a runtime benchmark, data-retention policy or incremental-learning flag. Wrapper recipes require explicit review; unlisted methods remain unreviewed.
